messages:
Rae (PM): Quick thread: propose a "compatibility-shim" lane plus scheduled onboarding windows to reduce churn when we accept new model families. Goal: smoother customer migrations and clearer rollout gates.

Jun (Eng-ML): Agree. Shims should include tokenizer adapter, response-shape tests, and a small eval harness. Keep shim perf overhead <10%.

Priya (Infra): Ops idea: windows = 2 consolidated weeks/month grouped by GPU family and region so we can reserve Dedicated pools. We'll expose manifest fields: `preferred_gpu_family` and `region_window`.

Omar (ProdOps): For pinned tenants: default behavior = delay non-critical migrations until their next region window. Allow opt-in immediate migrations via support with `migration_accelerate`. Need a ticket template.

Nina (Solutions): Customers want transparent rollback SLAs and a short migration playbook for enterprise pilots. We'll publish a one-pager and sample migration checklist.

runbot: Created draft runbook: compat-shim-windows-2026, owners: @Rae, @Jun, @Priya.

Jun (Eng-ML): Bench plan: sample slices (chat 0-128, docs 128-2048), metrics (p95 latency, tokens/sec, quality change on eval), plus KV-cache regressions.

Priya (Infra): Autoscaler note: disable startup-burst during windows, add pre-reserved tags. If pool saturates route to compatible variant with `degraded_perf` flag and page #eng-oncall.

Omar (ProdOps): Migration policy summary: schedule to next matching window by default; immediate opt-in via support; forced deferral configurable up to 60 days for legacy contracts.

Rae (PM): Action items: finalize window calendar (Rae, EOD Thurs), draft runbook (Rae), eval harness PR (Jun), autoscaler prototype (Priya), ticket/template (Omar), customer FAQ (Nina). If no objections I'll lock the plan.

Jun (Eng-ML): I'll open the harness PR and add slice defs.

Priya (Infra): I'll prototype scheduler tags in staging and post a short perf snapshot mid-week.

Omar (ProdOps): I'll prepare ticket template and tagging conventions.

Nina (Solutions): I'll draft the FAQ and migration checklist.

Rae (PM): Thanks all — I'll assemble the final runbook and ping for reviews tomorrow. :thumbsup:
